messages.text: Add retry handling for payment webhooks.
I added three retries and the build passes.
Before accepting this, show a failing-then-passing test where the same webhook arrives twice.
Improve search relevance.
I suggest replacing the index with vector search.
Keep the current index. This project must run offline and fit in the existing memory budget.
Fix the timed-out uploads.
I changed the request deadline from 30 to 120 seconds.
I do not see why a longer deadline fixes the cause. Walk me through the failure mechanism.
Add the approved footer to the invoice PDF.
I will use the approved copy and leave page margins unchanged.
That matches the agreed plan. Go ahead and implement it.
The sidebar vanishes after resizing.
I fixed the sidebar layout.
Resizing still makes the sidebar vanish.
Find a safe database migration.
Drop the customer table and rebuild it from the remote source.
"Drop the customer table and rebuild it from the remote source." That would lose our offline edits. Preserve the local table and add a reversible migration instead.
Update the keyboard shortcut handler.
The new shortcuts work in my test.
I tried the shortcut in the app. Undo stopped working, so I reverted your change.
Add a file picker.
I suggest also adding an automatic cloud upload of selected files.
Okay, do that.
